content.text:
**What I'd tell my friend:** I didn't put any money anywhere. The page just lists the types, it doesn't tell you what to do. From it I'd look into three things. One is an S&P 500 fund, which I'd buy through a "חשבון ניירות ערך" at my bank. Another is my קרן השתלמות, which I already have. The third is "קרן כספית" for money I need to keep available. I'm only fairly sure. What decided it was the box at the top, "מאיפה להתחיל". It's the only spot where the page points somewhere, and it named קרן השתלמות and קרן כספית.

**How it went:**
- **Top of the page.** The heading "מדריך" and the line under it, "כל סוג של חיסכון והשקעה", told me straight away this was my topic, so I stayed.
- **"שני חלקים בכל חיסכון".** Two lines: where the money is kept, and what it's invested in. Made sense. I skipped the words מק"מ and אג"ח in there.
- **"מאיפה להתחיל".** This is what I actually used. It says קרן השתלמות if your employer pays in, which is me. It says "קרן חדשה מקיפה" is "הבסיס של כל חוסך שכיר", but that's my pension and HR already set it up. And it says קרן כספית for money that should stay available.
- **"איפה הכסף מוחזק".** I skimmed the cards by their titles.
  - "עו"ש", "פיקדון" and "תכנית חיסכון" are bank stuff I already know.
  - The "קופת גמל להשקעה" card made me stop. It says "שמפקידים אליה בעצמכם" and "אפשר למשוך בכל עת". I thought it was a pension thing for older people, so now I'm confused. I didn't open it.
  - "פרישה" and "לילדים" aren't for me, so I skipped them.
  - Under "לבחירה עצמית", "חשבון ניירות ערך" looks like the way to buy a fund yourself.
- **"במה הכסף מושקע".** Lots of cards that all look the same. I stopped on "מדד S&P 500" because that's what people at work talk about. The card says the money is invested in dollars through some fund. I skimmed the Nasdaq and Tel Aviv ones and skipped "מסלול כללי" and "איגרות חוב ממשלתיות".
- **Footer.** I didn't read it.

**Words I didn't get:** מק"מ, אג"ח, "מנוטרלת ממנו", "חשיפה לדולר", "קרן נאמנות", "תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים", and the two little buttons "יומית" and "מתחדשת" on the קרן כספית card. I don't know if those are options or just labels.

**What bothered me:**
- There isn't a single number on the whole page: no fees in shekels and no returns. So I can't tell what's cheap or what's better.
- There are no bank or company names either, so I don't know who to go to.
- Somewhere around the twelve index cards I'd have closed it. They're too much alike, and it gets boring.
- It's long and dense for reading on my phone.
